hypothesis: With persistent per-step causal regimes A→B→A, can a native HybridPilot using only actually selected action histories and prior observed effects recover useful A behavior after B and select lower-regret actions than the strongest trained conventional SSM256 or linear7 under the same factual FIT examples and model update budget?

world.origin: F8-R3 pre-existing author-generated mathematical recurrence y(s,a,z)=0.5*s+0.3*z*(a-int(s>=0)); no external CausalGym imports or F7 replay
world.hidden_sign_trajectory: z[t]=initial for t<switch1 or t>=switch2; -initial otherwise
world.factual_action: at steps 0,switch1,switch2 take off-policy action 1-int(s>=0); other steps take int(s>=0) XOR int((seed+7*step)%3==0)
world.training_observations: P80 normalized 16D factual public-state/action key + 16D observed-effect vector; model sees only effects at times strictly BEFORE predicted action

models.checkpoint: final update 96; diagnostic measured not used for tuning

outcome.primary: mean one-step model-selected action regret after return to latent regime A on 12 unfamiliar scheduled-score worlds, goal +0.2 if world index even else -0.2; evaluator scores realized synthetic chosen action and two-action oracle AFTER choice
outcome.decision: predict both action effects at next t=12 from entire 12-step already factual history; model chooses min goal-squared predicted next state; tie action0; inverse tanh clamp [-.98,.98], scale2.4
outcome.baseline_selection: strongest score-world mean action-regret among six fixed trained conventional seed instances (3 linear7, 3 SSM256), selected for conservative DEV comparison only, not scientific tuning
outcome.threshold: candidate achieves >=10% relative less mean regret than strongest fixed conventional comparator in >=2/3 seeds; paired 12-world bootstrap 2.5th percentile baseline-regret minus candidate-regret > 0
outcome.retention_condition: cold restored same candidate checkpoint exactly reproduces A-return predictions; no assertion that this demonstrates unseen real retention
outcome.support: masked causal prequential physical delta MSE in initial A/B/returned A, and delayed-one-effect negative readout; preserve all nulls
outcome.controls: same original factual trajectories/actions for all models, extra model parameters and measured training/inference wall costs reported, conventional baseline fit is bounded not independently convergence certified
outcome.possible_noncompetence: If trained conventional baselines not converged or no discriminating action goal, label inconclusive; never reclassify as scientific PASS

tests: full phase receipt and no source effects
all four arms each trained across 3 seeds, exact update budgets
unfamiliar switch timing on synthetic test only
document and retain no-go regardless of outcome
